title: lupinus lepidus subsp. cusickii
intro: Lupinus lepidus subsp. cusickii, commonly known as Cusick's lupine, is a subspecies of the Lupinus lepidus plant, belonging to the legume family. It is a perennial plant native to the western United States and Canada, known for its delicate purple flowers and narrow, lance-shaped leaves. The health benefits of Cusick's lupine include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular-protective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other flavonoids, which have been shown to contribute to its medicinal properties.
